title: Module 3: Dynamic Programming & Greedy Algorithms
subject: Advanced Data Structures
author: Mathews S. (Batch 23-27)
rawContent: Dynamic Programming characteristics: Optimal Substructure and Overlapping Subproblems. Memoization vs Tabulation. 0/1 Knapsack O(nW), Longest Common Subsequence matrix, and Matrix Chain Multiplication. Greedy approach for Fractional Knapsack, Huffman Coding, and Dijkstra's Algorithm.

title: Module 2: CMOS Stick Diagrams & Euler Path
subject: VLSI Design
author: Thomas B. (Batch 23-27)
rawContent: Stick diagrams using lambda design rules for static CMOS. Colored layers: Polysilicon (red), Diffusion (green/yellow), Metal 1 (blue). Euler path algorithm to minimize diffusion breaks.

title: Module 1: Bayes Decision Theory & Classifier Rules
subject: Pattern Recognition
author: Jeeva J. (Batch 23-27)
rawContent: Bayesian Decision Theory: Prior, Likelihood, Posterior. Minimum Error Rate Classification and Risk Minimization. Discriminant functions for multivariate Gaussian distributions.
